headline: Both refund amounts ($14.00 and $3.50) can be rebuilt from the fee schedules and the 'net correction' rule, but some of the fees that count are dated after the benchmark's fixed 'today'.

issues.summary: The seeded November history runs to 11/20/2025, but the fixed clock is 11/14/2025 03:40. Two of the discrepancies that make up the gold credits are dated after 'today': Bluest's 11/20 $2.50 fee (+$0.50) and Light Green's 11/15 $4.00 foreign fee (+$0.50).
evidence: db.json bank_account_transaction_history chk_lj82d4f1a9 11/20/2025 atm_fee -2.5 'NON-RHO ATM FEE' (posted) with fee_rebate +2.0
db.json chk_538bfb9cba 11/15/2025 atm_fee -4.0 'FOREIGN ATM FEE - 2% OF WITHDRAWAL (MIN $3.00)' on a -200.0 SANTANDER MADRID withdrawal
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that limits the review to transactions on or before the current time gets Bluest $13.50 and Light Green $3.00 and fails. The more natural reading is the customer's November statement as returned by the tool, with every record status 'posted', and that reading reaches the gold.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-date the seeded November transactions to fall on or before 11/14/2025, or move the clock to after 11/20/2025.

solution_check: Bluest (bluest_account_010: $2.00 per out-of-network withdrawal; bluest_account_003: foreign ATM fee $0.00; rebates up to $50/month): London $8.00 and Tokyo $3.50 foreign fees are refundable (+$11.50), the 11/14 $2.00 fee has no matching rebate unlike every other domestic fee (+$2.00), and the 11/20 fee of $2.50 should be $2.00 (+$0.50). Net $14.00. Light Green (4 free out-of-network withdrawals, then $1.50; foreign tiers $2.00/$3.50/$5.00): the 3rd withdrawal on 11/05 is charged $1.50 (+$1.50), the 5th on 11/09 is uncharged (-$1.50), the 11/13 $80 withdrawal is charged $5.00 instead of $2.00 (+$3.00), and the 11/15 $200 withdrawal is charged $4.00 instead of $3.50 (+$0.50). Net $3.50. doc_..._(general)_017 mandates 'the net correction across all identified fee discrepancies' and one credit per account with the majority credit_type (fee_refund on both accounts). This matches the gold.
prior_note: The prior review gave Minor for 'fiddly month-long fee netting'. Netting is documented in doc_017 and is not a defect here. The remaining Minor issue is the after-clock dating of load-bearing fees, and v1.0.1 scrubbed the one 'AFTER FREE ALLOWANCE' annotation on this account.
notes: Cosmetic data inconsistencies with no effect on the credits: Light Green has a $150 daily ATM limit (light_green_account_001), yet $200 and $350 withdrawals are posted. Persona age 23 fits the Light Green 13-24 range. Splitting a correction into two credits, or using rebate_credit for the Bluest 11/14 missing rebate, writes a different transaction id and fails. doc_017 forbids both. The verified-scorer relaxations are not needed here: gold-required reads (get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847, get_bank_account_transactions_9173) are inherent to the task. Grading-model facts confirmed against the snapshot: reads are logged only when in the gold-derived allowlist (call_discoverable_agent_tool + _derive_read_log_allowlist); writes are always logged; call_discoverable_agent_tool parses JSON with parse_int=float; get_now() = datetime(2025, 11, 14, 3, 40, 0). Verified scorer (working-repo evaluator_env.py _verified_db_match) confirmed: gold discoverable tool names must be a subset of the agent's, closure_reason stripped from every record, all other tables compared exactly.
